text: {"rules":[{"id":"CRC-SCREEN-45-49","version":"2021","title":"Colorectal cancer screening, adults aged 45 to 49 years","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for colorectal cancer in adults aged 45 to 49 years.","grade":"B","effective_date":"2021","action":"Screen for colorectal cancer using one of the Table 1 strategies: annual high-sensitivity gFOBT or FIT, sDNA-FIT every 1 to 3 years, colonoscopy every 10 years, CT colonography every 5 years, flexible sigmoidoscopy every 5 years, or flexible sigmoidoscopy every 10 years plus annual FIT.","denominator":"{\"age\":{\"min\":45,\"max\":49,\"at\":\"end\"},\"quote\":\"Adults aged 45 to 49 years\"}","numerator":"{\"any\":[{\"observation\":{\"concept\":\"fobt\",\"window\":[\"{MY}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"],\"pick\":\"any\"},\"quote\":\"Every year\",\"note\":\"Covers the High-sensitivity gFOBT and FIT rows, both annual; the fobt concept covers gFOBT or FIT.\"},{\"observation\":{\"concept\":\"fit_dna\",\"window\":[\"{MY-2}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"],\"pick\":\"any\"},\"quote\":\"Every 1 to 3 c y\",\"derived\":{\"window\":\"Interval is stated as 1 to 3 years. The longest interval (3 y) was used, so tests dated MY-2 through MY count. Footnote c is not provided. Needs human review.\"}},{\"procedure\":{\"concept\":\"colonoscopy\",\"window\":[\"{MY-9}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"]},\"quote\":\"Every 10 y\",\"derived\":{\"window\":\"Every 10 y for a Dec-31 check covers MY-9 through MY.\"}},{\"procedure\":{\"concept\":\"ct_colonography\",\"window\":[\"{MY-4}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"]},\"quote\":\"Every 5 y\",\"derived\":{\"window\":\"Every 5 y for a Dec-31 check covers MY-4 through MY.\"}},{\"procedure\":{\"concept\":\"flexible_sigmoidoscopy\",\"window\":[\"{MY-4}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"]},\"quote\":\"Every 5 y\",\"derived\":{\"window\":\"Every 5 y for a Dec-31 check covers MY-4 through MY.\"}},{\"all\":[{\"procedure\":{\"concept\":\"flexible_sigmoidoscopy\",\"window\":[\"{MY-9}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"]},\"quote\":\"Flexible sigmoidoscopy every 10 y\",\"derived\":{\"window\":\"Every 10 y for a Dec-31 check covers MY-9 through MY.\"}},{\"observation\":{\"concept\":\"fobt\",\"window\":[\"{MY}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"],\"pick\":\"any\"},\"quote\":\"FIT every year\"}],\"quote\":\"Flexible sigmoidoscopy with FIT\"}],\"quote\":\"screening for colorectal cancer\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["The section text gives no effective date. Version and effective_date were set to '2021' from the document id (uspstf_crc_2021); a human should confirm the exact publication date.","The section states no exclusions, so exclusions is empty. Common measure exclusions (history of colorectal cancer, total colectomy, hospice, deceased) are not in the text and were not added.","Footnotes a, b and c (on 'Screening method', 'Frequency' and the sDNA-FIT interval) are referenced but their text is not provided, so any conditions in them are not represented.","The sDNA-FIT interval is stated as 'Every 1 to 3 c y'. The 3-year upper bound was used (window MY-2..MY) and marked as derived. The table also says modeling suggests 3-year screening is not a favorable balance compared with sDNA-FIT every 1 or 2 y. This is a judgment a human reviewer should resolve.","The table says high-sensitivity gFOBT (eg, Hemoccult SENSA) is required and outperforms older tests (eg, Hemoccult II). The fobt concept cannot tell high-sensitivity gFOBT from older guaiac tests, so older-test results may be counted incorrectly.","The FIT threshold detail (20 μg hemoglobin per gram of feces, used in CISNET modeling) is not represented.","Not represented: follow-up colonoscopy after abnormal stool, CT colonography or sigmoidoscopy results; adherence over multiple rounds of testing; dietary restrictions and three stool samples for gFOBT; bowel preparation and anesthesia requirements; and evaluation of extracolonic findings on CT colonography.","Not represented: product and test choice considerations, including declining availability of flexible sigmoidoscopy and age-related colonoscopy harms. The 'Practice Considerations' section is referenced but not included.","The flexible sigmoidoscopy every 10 y plus annual FIT strategy is encoded as its own branch. Its annual FIT component already satisfies the standalone annual stool-test branch, so the branch is logically redundant but kept for fidelity to the table.","Stool-based tests (fobt, fit_dna) are encoded as observations with pick 'any' and no value threshold. Only completion of the test is checked, not the result."]}
